excerpt.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
excerpt.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. Thi

scope.zh: 静滞监狱全部7个事件与粒子谜题项目。
scope.en: All 7 Stasis Prison events and the Particle Mystery project.

texts.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
texts.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. This state of unrest is causing considerable problems for our day-to-day operations.

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetName]上100£pop£人口失踪。我们将部署一套昂贵的跟踪监控系统来帮助我们解决这个谜团。
tooltips.en: 100 £pop£ Pops have gone missing from [Root.GetName]. An expensive tracking system will be used to help us solve this mystery.

label.en: There is no need to panic.

texts.zh:
得益于在[Root.GetName]上部署的追踪系统，我们获得了重要的线索。

在近期[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪案例中，我们都在事件发生后迅速进行了扫描，进而得到了他们最后出现的位置。而在每个案例中，我们都发现了一种衰变的带电粒子残留物。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
texts.en:
Thanks to the implementation of the tracking system on [Root.GetName] we have a substantial lead.

As the most recent of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] disappeared, and we quickly followed up with a scan of their last location ping. A decaying residue of charged particles was found in each instance.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上取得了幸运的突破！我们发现了最近失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的去处。对这块区域的详细扫描发现了一些带电粒子的衰变痕迹。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
texts.en:
We've had a lucky break on [Root.GetName]! We have uncovered the location of the most recent [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to go missing. A detailed scan of the area revealed a decaying residue of charged particles.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

label.en: Get to the bottom of this.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetColonistPluralCap]最近开始一个接一个地失踪。调查发现了一些独特的带电粒子残留。我们会利用所有已知的信息来寻找失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
texts.en: [Owner.GetColonistPluralCap] on [Root.GetName] have been disappearing. A break in the investigation indicated the presence of a uniquely charged particle residue. We will use all available information to locate the missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

texts.zh:
参照残留痕迹，我们通过全恒星系的扫描，在[Root.GetName]的卫星上发现了那些粒子的存在证据。

通过搜索卫星表面，我们找到了一坐被沙尘掩埋了数百年的小型气闸。其中是一座被遗弃的行政办公复合体、一台远距离物质传送机和一个连接在极先进静滞仓网络的力场操纵系统。

静滞仓中冷冻着许多个体，其中也包括我们失踪的殖民者。几乎可以肯定这座设施就是一座监狱。我们还需要弄清楚他们被抓进来的原因以及解救的方法。
texts.en:
Using the residue as a reference, a system-wide scan found evidence of the particles within [Root.GetName]'s moon.

A search of the lunar surface revealed a few small airlocks buried under centuries of dust. Inside was an abandoned complex of admin offices, long-range matter transporters, and field manipulation systems connected to a network of highly advanced stasis pods.

Frozen in the pods were many individuals, including our missing colonists. There is little doubt that this facility functioned as a prison. We have yet to determine why they were taken and how we can free them.

texts.zh:
真相和阴谋相去甚远，我们失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]是由于系统故障而遭到关押。

计算机的一个故障激活了监狱老旧的传送系统，随机地将几位我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]定罪。这座设施的建造者将这些静滞仓兼用于囚禁犯人和再教育功能。将我们的人口释放出来相对容易，但许多这些囚犯仍被困在静滞场中。尽管我们可以将他们释放，但由于没有犯罪记录，我们无法完整得知这些人的犯罪过往。

或者，我们可以修复这座监狱，让专职的监狱长控制它的传送系统。
texts.en:
Far from a conspiracy, our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were imprisoned because of a glitch.

A computer error reactivated the prison's aging transporter system and randomly identified our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] as guilty. The facility's architects used the pods for both prisoner storage and re-education. Freeing our people was relatively easy, but many original prisoners are still stuck in stasis fields. It should be possible to release them, although the lack of prison records means we cannot know the full extent of their criminal pasts.

Alternatively, we could restore the prison, giving special wardens control of its transporter system.

label.zh: 这可是不规矩的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]们的好去处。

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们也会获得一座可用的静滞监狱。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will gain a functional stasis prison.

label.zh: 绝不可以把人关在这样的监狱里。
label.en: No one belongs in a prison like this.

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归，我们也将关停这座监狱。其余的囚犯将被释放，但可能对我们的殖民地造成负面影响。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return and we will shut down the prison. The remaining prisoners will be freed, which could have negative effects for the colony.

label.zh: 设置一项逐步释放计划。
label.en: Set up a gradual release program.

tooltips.zh: 我们将对离开监狱的犯人进行筛查和帮助，以促进殖民地的平稳过渡。
tooltips.en: We will screen and support individuals as they leave the prison, facilitating a smoother transition for the colony.

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们会将这座监狱改造成食物工厂，让蜂巢得意享用这些静滞羁押的囚犯。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will modify the prison as a food factory, allowing the hive to feast on the prisoners in stasis.

notes.zh: 审阅注：四种处置——留作监狱（静滞监狱矿藏，结束）；释放（非格式塔）→ 60–120天后随机：坏邻居25/大杂烩50/好邻居25，亲外与排外帝国权重各±15；逐步释放（和平、平等或警察国家）→ 融合矿藏与新人口，结束；吞噬虫群 → 当作储备食物，结束。
notes.en: Review note: four choices — keep it as a prison (stasis prison deposit, end); release them (non-gestalt) → 60–120 days later at random Bad 25 / Mixed 50 / Good 25, shifted ±15 for xenophile or xenophobe empires; gradual release (pacifist, egalitarian or Police State) → integration deposit and new pops, end; Devouring Swarm → stored meals, end.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是顽固的犯罪分子。突然将他们成群释放会对殖民地造成问题。
texts.en: Most of the released prisoners on [Root.GetName] were hardened criminals. Having the group of them suddenly released has been causing issues for the colony.

note.zh: 释放的囚犯多为罪犯：1800天犯罪修正，新增人口。
note.en: Mostly criminals: a 1800-day crime modifier and new pops.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯既有顽固的犯罪分子也有政治意见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

虽然这些文化囚犯很高兴与我们分享他们的知识，但许多罪犯走投无路又开始重操旧业。
texts.en:
The prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were a mix of hardened criminals and political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

While the cultural prisoners are happy to share their knowledge with us, lacking any other option, many of the criminals have reverted to their old ways.

note.zh: 罪犯与异见者兼有：两种修正，新增人口。
note.en: Criminals and dissidents alike: both modifiers and new pops.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是政治异见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

在重获自由之后他们很乐意与我们分享他们的文化和知识。
texts.en:
Almost all of the prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

They're happily sharing their culture and knowledge with us now that they have been given their freedom.

note.zh: 几乎全是艺术家、作家等异见者：永久修正，新增人口。
note.en: Almost all artists and other dissidents: a permanent modifier and new pops.

summary.text:
# 晨间打卡缺席 / Missed The Morning Check-in（静滞监狱 · Stasis Prison）

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 殖民地事件链 colony event chain
- 来源 Sources：`events/colony_events_3.txt:9073–9540` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:1787–1806` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3882`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地满五年时（`on_colony_5_years_old`），随机池以权重 3 抽中 colony.9900（注释 “Dimensional Prison”）。要求：人口超过 400（脚本单位）、本身不是卫星但有卫星、非人造星球、非母星/非首都的非 AI 殖民地；全银河一次（`dimensional_prison_colony`）。

At the fifth anniversary (weight 3) on a large, non-artificial colony that has a moon; once per galaxy.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **晨间打卡缺席（9900）**：大量殖民者失踪（立即一人消失）。花 500 能量植入追踪器（“安心追踪”修正）→ 180–360 天后；或“没有必要恐慌”（“集体自我恐惧”修正）→ 360–720 天后——都到达 **扫描成功（9905）**（正文按先前选择不同）。
2. 项目 **粒子谜题**（科研船+科学家，180 天）→ **待机模式（9910）**：失踪者在卫星上的静滞监狱里 → 60–120 天 → **逃离卫星（9915）**：监狱里还关着大批外星囚犯。
3. 处置方式见下。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 留作监狱：获得静滞监狱矿藏，结束。/ Keep the prison: a stasis prison deposit.
- 释放（非格式塔）→ 60–120 天后随机：**坏邻居（9920）** 25、**大杂烩（9925）** 50、**好邻居（9930）** 25；亲外帝国坏 −15/好 +15，排外相反。/ Release them: random Bad/Mixed/Good 25/50/25, ±15 by xenophile/xenophobe.
- 逐步释放（和平主义、平等主义或警察国家）：融合矿藏，新物种人口，结束。/ Gradual release: integration deposit and new pops.
- 吞噬虫群：把他们当作“预包装餐食”，结束。/ Devouring Swarm: pre-packaged meals.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

见上：释放需非格式塔；逐步释放与“餐食”按理念/公民性显示。/ See above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对 9900–9930 全部脚本、项目与随机池；编译草稿正确；标注三个随机结局与 9915 的四种处置。/ Draft correct; endings and the four choices annotated.
